findings.body: The loader hard-codes every generation as non-synthetic. Consequently, the generated workbook used by the disposable-database harness is persisted with `isSynthetic: false`, and the unit test explicitly expects that incorrect provenance. This violates the requirement that every synthetic result be labelled; the test harness needs a guarded test-only way to mark its generated batch without exposing a production completeness override.
findings.title: Not done: every synthetic result is labelled

findings.body: Batch-level `sourceReportingMonths` is populated only from the Actual parser. A valid Budget month absent from the Actual sheet will therefore be omitted from the ingestion batch and CLI report even though budget rows and `budgetCoverage` for that month are persisted. The required source-month metadata should use the union of the Actual and Budget parser month sets, with a test where those sets differ.
findings.title: Not done: source-month metadata includes all workbook months

findings.body: This file remains outside every permitted path and contains only branch workflow/review state, not implementation or test evidence needed by the operator loader. Its presence contradicts the declared absence of unnecessary out-of-scope changes and should be removed from the branch.
findings.title: Remove the out-of-scope task-state artifact
